GOVERNMENT OF INDIA
OFFICE OF THE ASSISTANT COMMISSIONER OF CENTRAL TAX
CUSTOMS & CENTRAL GST COMMISSIONERATE, CHENNAI OUTER

Form GST RFD-08 Show Cause Notice for Rejection of Refund
Reference No: RFD08/TN/2023-24/808
Date: 12-12-2023

To,
M/s Global Garments Exports
GSTIN: 33GGGHH7890G1Z1
Financial Year: 2023-24

1. WHEREAS, you filed an application for refund of unutilized Input Tax Credit in Form GST RFD-01 under ARN AA3308230012345 dated 15-10-2023 claiming refund of Rs. 3,50,000/- on zero-rated export of goods without payment of tax under Letter of Undertaking (LUT).

2. AND WHEREAS, during verification of export documents attached with the application under Rule 89(2) of the CGST Rules 2017, the officer examined Shipping Bills, Export Invoices, and Bank Realization Certificates.

3. IT IS OBSERVED that out of total export turnover claimed, Bank Realization Certificates (BRC) / Foreign Inward Remittance Certificates (FIRC) establishing realization of export proceeds in convertible foreign exchange were not submitted within the statutory timeline prescribed under Foreign Exchange Management Act (FEMA).

4. ACCORDINGLY, under Section 54(3) of the CGST Act 2017 read with Rule 96B of the CGST Rules 2017, where any refund of unutilized ITC has been paid and export proceeds are not realized within time, the refund claim is ineligible.

5. NOW THEREFORE, you are called upon to show cause why your refund application for Rs. 3,50,000/- should not be rejected in full under Section 54(5) of the Act.

6. You are directed to file your reply in Form GST RFD-09 along with copy of e-BRC issued by authorized dealer bank within 15 days of receipt of this notice.
